text:
morgan: heads-up — planning a small rollout to shift 10% traffic from default-route -> lowcost-cohort to ease eu-west1 hot node. will do cohort hash bump + routing weight change. thinking canary 1% first.
 sam: +1 but remember quota accounting weirdness last time — quota.unused and quota.usage_by_cohort got noisy. monitor that.
 lei: do we have telemetry tags in place? need route.cohort.weight and quota.usage_by_cohort surfaced plus cohort_id tag.
 oliver: I can add a temp panel, but sampling is at 1% globally. suggest bump to 5% scoped to this rollout for 10m.
 morgan: rollout plan: canary 1% for 10m -> if ok, 5% for 10m -> 10%. rollback if error rate > 0.5% or quota delta > +20%.
 sam: also ensure console preview shows the effective config for affected tenants. last time API vs console drifted.
 lei: adding evals: alerts.slo.latency and alerts.quota.delta. will wire alerts to slack channel #eng-oncall.
 sam: good. also add a smoke test that hits both default & cohort routes and checks response shape.
 morgan: ops-bot, create rollout job with canary=1%, window=10m, auto-rollback thresholds applied.
 ops-bot: action: created rollout r-6765432100 (initiator=morgan), canary=1%, window=10m, auto-rollback thresholds set.
 oliver: infra: please warm KV prefix for cohort keys: `curl -X POST https://infra/api/cache/warm?prefix=cohort_lowcost`
 infra-bot: cache-warm job queued (cw-9876). ETA ~45s.
 morgan: telemetry note — please tag samples with `cohort_preview=true` so we can filter historic traces.
 sam: don’t increase sampling cluster-wide. scope the sampling change to the rollout tag only.
 lei: will add dashboard variables and a compare-by-cohort view (latency, p50/p95, quota delta, error-rate).
 samira: I'm on call and watching alerts :eyes:
 ops-bot: rollout r-6765432100: canary 1% started. monitor: https://console/redwood/rollouts/r-6765432100
 morgan: canary looks stable at +5m. latency flat, quota delta +2%. bumping to 5% now.
 oliver: keep sampling at 5% for 15m so we get decent signals.
 lei: dashboard link: https://console/redwood/dashboards/cohort-routing-comparison (vars: region=eu-west1, cohort=lowcost)
 samira: saw tiny error spike for tenant-42 — investigating now.
 morgan: pausing rollout for tenant-42 only and rolling back that tenant to default-route. filing follow-up.
 sam: nice scoped rollback. open a ticket if it recurs and include traces.
 morgan: filed ISSUE-2412 with logs and screenshots: https://issues/redwood/ISSUE-2412
 ops-bot: rollout r-6765432100: paused at 2026-03-22T10:15:30Z by morgan (reason: tenant-42 errors).
 lei: quick root-cause note: tenant-42 uses legacy header `X-Cohort-Override` that our new router ignored, so they got partial-state routing. fix is to honor legacy header for flagged-tenants.
 oliver: will prep a small router patch (route-compat: honor X-Cohort-Override) and staged deploy.
 sam: after patch, re-run the rollout with narrower cohort increments (2% -> 5% -> 10%) and keep telemetry sampling high for first 30m.
 morgan: agreed. schedule patch + slow re-rollout. thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:
 samira: slack thread OK, I'll keep monitoring and escalate if alerts fire.
 ops-bot: reminder: remember to remove elevated sampling after 2 hours to avoid billing surprise.
 morgan: noted — will add cleanup job after rollout completes.
 lei: also adding a dashboard annotation for the rollout windows so we can correlate spikes.
 morgan: closing for now, follow-up ticket will track the router patch & re-rollout timeline.
